title: Cinematic Video Prompt Builder Input
description: User-friendly input contract for building polished cinematic video prompts from a simple brief, with support for multi-shot single-video output, optional second-by-second timed multi-shot planning, continuous multi-video stories, multi-video creative variations, storytelling presets such as ASMR, dialogue-driven, silent visual, dreamlike, cartoon, action, and relaxing ambient modes, dialogue-language detection, provider-specific profiles for generic video models, Seedance 2 multimodal references, Veo 3.1 frame and image guidance, and either normal-background or green-screen video output.

topic.title: Topic / Core Idea
topic.description: The main idea, scene, product, or story moment. If this is the only field the user gives, the skill should infer the best cinematic treatment automatically.

prompt_goal.title: Prompt Goal
prompt_goal.description: Optional expansion of the topic. Describe the video you want to create in plain language. Focus on the main subject, what happens, and the feeling you want.

project_title.title: Project Title
project_title.description: Optional short name for this prompt request.

creative_direction_mode.title: Cinematic Decision Mode
creative_direction_mode.description: Choose whether the skill should let the LLM decide the best cinematic treatment for you, pick a more random but still context-appropriate cinematic direction, or follow your manual selections more closely. If omitted, it should behave as Auto Best.

oneOf.title: Auto Best / LLM Best
oneOf.description: Recommended. The skill chooses the most fitting cinematic treatment automatically from the topic, context, and references.

oneOf.title: Random Cinematic
oneOf.description: The skill chooses a bolder and less expected cinematic interpretation automatically, while still staying relevant to the topic.

oneOf.title: Surprise Me (Legacy Alias)
oneOf.description: Legacy alias for Random Cinematic. Keeps compatibility with earlier inputs while using the same behavior.

oneOf.title: Manual Guided
oneOf.description: The skill respects your explicit controls more closely, while still polishing wording and filling gaps.

storytelling_preset.title: Storytelling Preset
storytelling_preset.description: Choose the overall storytelling flavor you want. Leave on Auto Popular if you want the skill to pick the most suitable narrative style from the topic.

oneOf.title: Auto Popular
oneOf.description: Recommended. Choose the most suitable storytelling style automatically from the topic and current short-form video patterns.

oneOf.title: Dialogue Skit
oneOf.description: Character-led short scene driven by short spoken exchanges, reactions, and timing.

oneOf.title: Voiceover Story
oneOf.description: Narration-led storytelling where voiceover or guided commentary carries the scene.

oneOf.title: Silent Visual Story
oneOf.description: Tell the story mainly through action, staging, camera, and atmosphere without spoken dialogue.

oneOf.title: ASMR / Sensory
oneOf.description: Focus on tactile details, close-up micro-actions, soothing texture, and sensory satisfaction.

oneOf.title: Relax / Ambient
oneOf.description: Create a calming atmospheric clip with soft motion, comfort, and environmental presence.

oneOf.title: Dreamlike / Poetic
oneOf.description: Use lyrical, soft, floating, or emotionally dreamlike storytelling.

oneOf.title: Surreal / Impossible
oneOf.description: Create original, imaginative imagery that goes beyond reality in a readable cinematic way.

oneOf.title: Cartoon Dialogue
oneOf.description: Animated or cartoon-style characters talk, react, and perform with clear expressive timing.

oneOf.title: Cartoon SFX Only
oneOf.description: Animated or cartoon-style storytelling driven by motion, comic timing, and sound-effect energy instead of speech.

oneOf.title: Action Showdown
oneOf.description: Create a readable confrontation, chase, or fight-oriented scene with clear cinematic geography.

oneOf.title: POV / Vlog
oneOf.description: A social-native or first-person-feeling version with immediacy and relatable presence.

oneOf.title: Documentary / Observational
oneOf.description: Grounded observational storytelling that feels lived-in, authentic, and cinematic.

oneOf.title: Explainer / Edutainment
oneOf.description: Educational storytelling that remains engaging, clear, and visually appealing.

oneOf.title: Product / Beauty Story
oneOf.description: Premium product-led storytelling with tactile detail, beauty framing, and aspirational mood.

generation_mode.title: Generation Mode
generation_mode.description: Choose the workflow this cinematic prompt should support. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to decide from the topic and references.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: If source video is present, use video edit. If reference images or first/last-frame anchors are present, use image to video. Otherwise use text to video.

oneOf.title: Text to Video
oneOf.description: Create a cinematic prompt from text only.

oneOf.title: Image to Video
oneOf.description: Use reference images, first/last-frame anchors, or other image-based guidance to anchor style, character, composition, or opening/ending frames.

oneOf.title: Video Edit
oneOf.description: Rewrite an existing clip while preserving its core structure.

target_model_profile.title: Target Model Profile
target_model_profile.description: Choose whether the prompt package should stay broadly compatible with generic video models, follow Seedance 2 specific multimodal reference behavior, or follow Veo 3.1 compatible image-reference behavior. If omitted by a programmatic caller, the schema should treat the request as generic compatibility mode.

oneOf.title: Generic Video Models
oneOf.description: Recommended default. Keep the prompt broadly portable across many video models. Image references stay within the standard 4-image workflow.

oneOf.title: Seedance 2 (Kie.ai)
oneOf.description: Enable Seedance 2 oriented multimodal guidance, including up to 9 image references and optional video/audio reference URLs.

oneOf.title: Veo 3.1 (Kie.ai)
oneOf.description: Enable Veo 3.1 compatible image-guided behavior, including first-frame or first-and-last-frame anchoring and reference-to-video with 1 to 3 images.

seedance_input_mode.title: Seedance Input Mode
seedance_input_mode.description: Only relevant when Target Model Profile is Seedance 2. Choose whether the request should use first-frame anchoring, first-and-last-frame anchoring, or Seedance's multimodal reference mode.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Infer the best Seedance 2 input mode from the references you provide.

oneOf.title: First Frame Only
oneOf.description: Anchor the clip from a provided first frame image.

oneOf.title: First and Last Frames
oneOf.description: Anchor both the opening and final frame from two provided images.

oneOf.title: Multimodal Reference
oneOf.description: Use Seedance 2 style mixed image, video, and audio references instead of first/last-frame mode.

veo_input_mode.title: Veo Input Mode
veo_input_mode.description: Only relevant when Target Model Profile is Veo 3.1. Choose whether the request should use a first frame, first and last frames, or Veo's reference-to-video mode.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Infer the best Veo 3.1 input mode from the references you provide.

oneOf.title: First Frame Only
oneOf.description: Anchor the clip from a provided first frame image.

oneOf.title: First and Last Frames
oneOf.description: Anchor both the opening and closing frame from two provided images.

oneOf.title: Reference to Video
oneOf.description: Use Veo 3.1 reference-to-video behavior with 1 to 3 reference images.

delivery_mode.title: Result Type
delivery_mode.description: Choose whether the skill should create one video with multiple cinematic shots inside the same prompt, or a package of separate video prompts. If you choose Multi Video, you must also choose whether the package is a continuous story or a set of creative variations.

oneOf.title: Multi Shot (Single Video)
oneOf.description: Default. Create one video prompt that may contain multiple shots or beats inside the same clip.

oneOf.title: Multi Video
oneOf.description: Create several separate video prompts. Use Multi Video Strategy to choose whether they continue the same story or act as different creative versions of the same topic.

multi_video_strategy.title: Multi Video Type
multi_video_strategy.description: Only relevant when Result Type is Multi Video. Choose one of the two Multi Video types: a continuous story package, or a package of creative variations from the same topic.

oneOf.title: Continuous Story
oneOf.description: Create separate prompts that continue the same character, environment, and narrative arc across clips.

oneOf.title: Creative Variations
oneOf.description: Create separate prompts that present the same topic in different moods, concepts, or cinematic angles for the user to choose from later.

video_count.title: Number of Videos
video_count.description: How many separate videos to generate when Result Type is Multi Video.

video_segments.title: Video Segments
video_segments.description: Define each separate video clip for Multi Video mode. Each item must include its own duration. Optional focus notes help the skill shape either the story progression or the creative variation direction across clips.

language.title: Output Language
language.description: Language used for the generated prompt and notes.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Choose whether the skill should return a plain text prompt package ready to use directly, or a structured JSON package for debugging, downstream parsing, or automation. Default is Plain Text because it is the most convenient for normal use.

oneOf.title: Plain Text
oneOf.description: Recommended default. Return only the final prompt text or prompt pack, ready to paste into a video model.

oneOf.title: Structured JSON
oneOf.description: Return a full JSON object matching the structured output contract for advanced workflows, automation, or debugging.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Frame shape for the cinematic composition. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to choose the most natural framing from the topic and context.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Choose the framing automatically from the topic, use case, and composition cues.

oneOf.title: 16:9 Landscape
oneOf.description: Best for cinematic horizontal video.

oneOf.title: 9:16 Vertical
oneOf.description: Best for reels, shorts, and mobile-first video.

oneOf.title: 1:1 Square
oneOf.description: Balanced square framing.

oneOf.title: 4:5 Portrait
oneOf.description: Social-friendly portrait framing.

duration_seconds.title: Preferred Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: Recommended range is 4 to 15 seconds for a single video prompt. When Result Type is Multi Video, use video_segments to define each clip duration separately. For the Veo 3.1 (Kie.ai) profile, treat the actual runtime as 8 seconds per generated clip.

multi_shot_timing_mode.title: Multi-Shot Timing Detail
multi_shot_timing_mode.description: Only relevant when Result Type is Multi Shot. Choose whether to leave shot timing untimed and let the skill infer pacing naturally, or provide an explicit second-by-second shot timeline inside the total clip duration.

oneOf.title: Untimed / Auto
oneOf.description: Default. Do not specify exact second ranges. The skill may infer internal pacing or use Scene Beats if you provide them.

oneOf.title: Timed Shot Timeline
oneOf.description: Specify each internal shot with explicit start and end seconds inside the total duration of the single video.

background_mode.title: Background Mode
background_mode.description: Choose whether the video should use a normal scenic background or a clean green-screen setup for later compositing. Default is Normal Background.

oneOf.title: Normal Background
oneOf.description: Use a normal scenic, designed, or environmental background that belongs inside the final video.

oneOf.title: Green Screen
oneOf.description: Use a clean chroma-green background for compositing. Prioritize the subject, props, framing, and keying-friendly separation over scenic environment detail.

audio_mode.title: Audio Mode
audio_mode.description: Choose how the clip should feel sonically. This guides how the prompt talks about speech, narration, ambience, or sound effects.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Infer the most suitable sound approach from the topic and storytelling preset.

oneOf.title: Spoken Dialogue
oneOf.description: Characters speak on screen and dialogue helps carry the scene.

oneOf.title: Voiceover
oneOf.description: Narration or voiceover leads the storytelling more than on-screen conversation.

oneOf.title: Ambience Only
oneOf.description: No spoken dialogue. Let atmosphere and environmental cues carry the clip.

oneOf.title: SFX Only
oneOf.description: No spoken dialogue. Use tactile, comic, or impact-oriented sound-effect cues instead.

oneOf.title: Music-Led Feel
oneOf.description: The scene should feel rhythmic or music-driven, with spoken content kept minimal.

oneOf.title: Near Silent
oneOf.description: Almost no sound cues besides minimal subtle atmosphere.

dialogue_language.title: Dialogue Language
dialogue_language.description: Language spoken by the characters. Auto detects from the user's writing language, or from any explicit language instruction found in the topic, prompt goal, dialogue, or notes.

dialogue_density.title: Dialogue Density
dialogue_density.description: How much spoken dialogue or vocal exchange the scene should carry. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the best approach from the topic, storytelling preset, and audio mode.

story_shape.title: Story Shape
story_shape.description: Choose how the internal progression of the clip should unfold. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the cleanest narrative shape.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Infer the best shape from the topic, preset, and duration.

oneOf.title: Single Moment
oneOf.description: One clear moment or emotional beat without major change.

oneOf.title: Three-Beat Micro Story
oneOf.description: A compact beginning, middle, and payoff structure.

oneOf.title: Reveal and Payoff
oneOf.description: Build anticipation, then land on a clear reveal or satisfying payoff.

oneOf.title: Conversation Loop
oneOf.description: Dialogue or reaction-led loop that feels replayable or episodic.

oneOf.title: Escalation
oneOf.description: Start controlled, then intensify tension, movement, or drama.

oneOf.title: Transformation
oneOf.description: Show a clear before-and-after or visible change over time.

oneOf.title: Cliffhanger
oneOf.description: End on a question, unresolved beat, or anticipation hook.

oneOf.title: Seamless Loop
oneOf.description: Land in a way that can loop smoothly back to the start.

ending_style.title: Ending Style
ending_style.description: Choose how the clip should land emotionally or structurally at the end.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Choose the best ending style from the topic, preset, and duration.

oneOf.title: Punchline
oneOf.description: End with a comedic beat, payoff, or memorable joke moment.

oneOf.title: Soft Resolve
oneOf.description: End gently and satisfyingly without a dramatic spike.

oneOf.title: Emotional Release
oneOf.description: End with a strong emotional breath, relief, warmth, or catharsis.

oneOf.title: Visual Reveal
oneOf.description: End on a strong image, hero frame, transformation, or reveal shot.

oneOf.title: Cliffhanger
oneOf.description: End on suspense, anticipation, or an unfinished turn.

oneOf.title: Loop Back
oneOf.description: End in a way that loops naturally back into the opening beat.

performance_style.title: Performance Style
performance_style.description: Choose how characters or animated subjects should behave, emote, and react on screen.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Infer the strongest performance style from the topic and preset.

oneOf.title: Naturalistic
oneOf.description: Subtle, believable, lived-in behavior.

oneOf.title: Playful
oneOf.description: Light, charming, expressive, and friendly interaction.

oneOf.title: Deadpan
oneOf.description: Calm, restrained, dry, or intentionally underplayed performance.

oneOf.title: Comedic Exaggerated
oneOf.description: More animated reactions and comedic emphasis while staying readable.

oneOf.title: Cartoon Expressive
oneOf.description: Highly readable animated posing, reactions, and cartoon-style timing.

oneOf.title: Heroic Action
oneOf.description: Confident, driven, physical, and action-ready performance.

imagination_level.title: Imagination Level
imagination_level.description: Choose how far the scene may go from realistic logic into stylized, dreamlike, or impossible imagery.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Infer the best imagination level from the topic and preset.

oneOf.title: Grounded
oneOf.description: Stay close to realistic or physically believable imagery.

oneOf.title: Stylized
oneOf.description: Polished and artistic, but still readable and coherent.

oneOf.title: Dreamlike
oneOf.description: Soft, lyrical, floating, or emotionally unreal.

oneOf.title: Surreal
oneOf.description: Unexpected combinations, symbolic imagery, or reality-bending visuals.

oneOf.title: Impossible
oneOf.description: Push into visually impossible but still cinematic, original, and readable imagery.

scene_arc.title: Scene Arc
scene_arc.description: Choose the overall structure of the clip. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the most cinematic arc from the topic, storytelling preset, and context.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Infer the most fitting cinematic arc from the topic and context.

oneOf.title: Single Moment
oneOf.description: One striking cinematic moment.

oneOf.title: Reveal
oneOf.description: Build toward a visual reveal or character introduction.

oneOf.title: Mini Story
oneOf.description: Short beginning, middle, and ending.

oneOf.title: Product Showcase
oneOf.description: Feature a product or object in a premium way.

oneOf.title: Action Sequence
oneOf.description: Fast motion and dynamic beats.

oneOf.title: Performance / Loop
oneOf.description: Stylized motion meant to feel rhythmic or loopable.

subject_count.title: Subject Count
subject_count.description: How many important on-screen subjects need to remain readable. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer this from the topic.

continuity_mode.title: Continuity Mode
continuity_mode.description: How the clip should feel structurally across time. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to choose the best cinematic flow.

motion_realism.title: Motion Realism
motion_realism.description: How grounded or stylized the movement should feel. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to match the topic naturally.

continuity_notes.title: Continuity Notes
continuity_notes.description: Optional fixed character, wardrobe, prop, environment, or story details that must stay consistent across prompts. If omitted, the skill must generate strong continuity notes automatically from the topic, prompt, and references.

reference_notes.title: Reference Notes
reference_notes.description: Optional notes about attached reference images or other stable visual anchors, especially identity, costume, props, and location details. If omitted, the skill must generate reference notes automatically from the image roles, image handles, topic, and any clearly implied character or scene details. If no images are attached, the generated reference notes should still act as a compact character or environment reference bible rather than merely stating that no reference images were provided.

main_subject.title: Main Subject
main_subject.description: Who or what is the main focus? Include appearance, wardrobe, product identity, or signature details.

setting.title: Setting / Environment
setting.description: Describe the location, background, weather, production design, or surrounding atmosphere.

action.title: Action / Motion
action.description: Describe what happens in the video and how the motion should unfold over time.

blocking_and_staging.title: Blocking and Staging
blocking_and_staging.description: Describe where the subject starts, how they move through the frame, and how the scene should be staged spatially.

foreground_midground_background.title: Foreground / Midground / Background
foreground_midground_background.description: Describe the visual layers of the frame to create depth and cinematic separation.

scene_beats.title: Scene Beats
scene_beats.description: Optional simple beat-by-beat plan. Use this when you want the prompt to follow a specific progression without assigning exact seconds. If a Timed Shot Timeline is also provided, treat Scene Beats as supporting context only.

beat_label.title: Beat Label
beat_label.description: Short name such as Opening, Middle, Ending, or Product Reveal.

camera_note.title: Camera Note
camera_note.description: Optional shot, framing, or camera movement note for this beat.

transition_note.title: Transition / Ending Note
transition_note.description: Optional cue for how this beat should flow into the next image or ending.

timed_shot_plan.title: Timed Shot Timeline
timed_shot_plan.description: Optional second-by-second multi-shot plan for a single video. Use this when you want to map the clip as explicit shot ranges such as 0-2s, 2-4s, 4-5s, and so on within the total duration.

shot_label.title: Shot Label
shot_label.description: Optional short name such as Shot 1, Opening Wide, Panic Push-In, or Laughing Payoff.

start_second.title: Start Second
start_second.description: When this shot should begin, measured from the start of the clip.

end_second.title: End Second
end_second.description: When this shot should end. This should be later than Start Second and should stay within the total clip duration.

shot_description.title: Shot Description
shot_description.description: What happens in this timed shot?

camera_note.title: Camera Note
camera_note.description: Optional framing, lens, or camera movement note for this shot.

audio_or_dialogue_cue.title: Audio / Dialogue Cue
audio_or_dialogue_cue.description: Optional cue for spoken dialogue, sound effects, ambience, or musical emphasis during this shot.

transition_note.title: Transition Note
transition_note.description: Optional note for how this shot should cut, intercut, escalate, or flow into the next shot.

dialogue_or_text.title: Dialogue or On-Screen Text
dialogue_or_text.description: Optional spoken line, narration cue, or on-screen text. Leave blank if you want the skill to infer or suppress speech from the storytelling preset and audio mode.

visual_style.title: Visual Style
visual_style.description: Overall cinematic style or production flavor. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the strongest match from the topic, storytelling preset, and references.

mood.title: Mood
mood.description: Overall emotional atmosphere. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the strongest mood from the topic, storytelling preset, and cinematic context.

camera_movement.title: Camera Movement
camera_movement.description: Dominant camera behavior for the prompt. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to choose the best move for the topic.

camera_angle.title: Camera Angle
camera_angle.description: Primary angle perspective for the scene. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the strongest angle.

shot_composition.title: Shot Composition
shot_composition.description: How the subject should generally be framed. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the most cinematic framing.

lens_look.title: Lens Look
lens_look.description: Select the lens feeling to translate into natural cinematic language. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to choose the best lens feel.

focus_strategy.title: Focus Strategy
focus_strategy.description: How focus and depth of field should guide attention. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the most natural cinematic focus.

lighting_style.title: Lighting Style
lighting_style.description: Primary lighting direction for the scene. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the strongest lighting setup.

time_of_day.title: Time of Day
time_of_day.description: Choose the time-of-day mood for the scene. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer it from the topic and lighting context.

atmospherics.title: Atmospherics
atmospherics.description: Optional atmospheric elements that add mood, depth, and realism.

production_design.title: Production Design / Mise-en-Scene
production_design.description: Describe architecture, props, wardrobe texture, set dressing, materials, and other visual design details.

color_palette.title: Color Palette
color_palette.description: Dominant color treatment or grading direction. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer the strongest cinematic palette.

color_contrast_strategy.title: Color Contrast Strategy
color_contrast_strategy.description: How color contrast should support the cinematic look. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to infer it.

editing_rhythm.title: Editing Rhythm
editing_rhythm.description: How the clip should feel in pacing and cut energy, even if the model renders it as one continuous scene. Leave on Auto if you want the skill to decide.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Optional reference images to guide the visual style, characters, or scene composition. In the default generic profile, use up to 4 images. In the Seedance 2 profile, use up to 9 images. In the Veo 3.1 reference-to-video profile, use up to 3 images. Upload order becomes @Image1, @Image2, and so on. Supports uploaded image paths, public URLs, or data URIs when provided programmatically.

reference_image_1_role.title: @Image1 Role
reference_image_1_role.description: Choose how the first uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Ignored if no first image is uploaded.

reference_image_2_role.title: @Image2 Role
reference_image_2_role.description: Choose how the second uploaded image should be used in the prompt. You may set this to character_reference as well when you want multiple character reference images. Ignored if no second image is uploaded.

reference_image_3_role.title: @Image3 Role
reference_image_3_role.description: Choose how the third uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Ignored if no third image is uploaded.

reference_image_4_role.title: @Image4 Role
reference_image_4_role.description: Choose how the fourth uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Ignored if no fourth image is uploaded.

reference_image_5_role.title: @Image5 Role
reference_image_5_role.description: Choose how the fifth uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Mainly for Seedance 2 style multimodal workflows. Ignored if no fifth image is uploaded.

reference_image_6_role.title: @Image6 Role
reference_image_6_role.description: Choose how the sixth uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Mainly for Seedance 2 style multimodal workflows. Ignored if no sixth image is uploaded.

reference_image_7_role.title: @Image7 Role
reference_image_7_role.description: Choose how the seventh uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Mainly for Seedance 2 style multimodal workflows. Ignored if no seventh image is uploaded.

reference_image_8_role.title: @Image8 Role
reference_image_8_role.description: Choose how the eighth uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Mainly for Seedance 2 style multimodal workflows. Ignored if no eighth image is uploaded.

reference_image_9_role.title: @Image9 Role
reference_image_9_role.description: Choose how the ninth uploaded image should be used in the prompt. Mainly for Seedance 2 style multimodal workflows. Ignored if no ninth image is uploaded.

reference_image_notes.title: Reference Image Guidance
reference_image_notes.description: Add extra guidance for how @Image1 to @Image9 should influence the prompt. Mention handles directly when helpful. Role fields take priority over these notes.

reference_videos.title: Reference Video URLs
reference_videos.description: Optional Seedance 2 style reference video URLs. Use these to guide motion, camera movement, blocking, editing rhythm, or scene dynamics without treating them as the editable source clip itself.

reference_audios.title: Reference Audio URLs
reference_audios.description: Optional Seedance 2 style reference audio URLs. Use these to guide rhythm, beat, lip-sync intent, dialogue pacing, or sonic mood.

first_frame_url.title: First Frame URL
first_frame_url.description: Optional first-frame image URL for Seedance 2 or Veo 3.1. Use this when you want the generated video to start from a specific opening frame.

last_frame_url.title: Last Frame URL
last_frame_url.description: Optional last-frame image URL for Seedance 2 or Veo 3.1. Use this together with First Frame URL when you want both the start and end frame anchored.

reference_asset_rights_confirmed.title: Reference Asset Rights Confirmed
reference_asset_rights_confirmed.description: Confirm that you have the right to use any public reference images, videos, audios, or frame URLs that you provide.

character_consistency.title: Protect Character Consistency
character_consistency.description: When enabled, the prompt should explicitly reinforce face, outfit, and identity stability.

source_video_url.title: Source Video URL
source_video_url.description: Optional source video URL. Only relevant when Generation Mode is Video Edit.

must_include.title: Must Include
must_include.description: Key elements that absolutely must appear or remain clear in the final prompt.

avoid.title: Avoid / Guardrails
avoid.description: Things the prompt should minimize or guard against, such as flicker, extra limbs, warped hands, weak motion, or generic styling.

additional_notes.title: Additional Notes
additional_notes.description: Optional extra direction for polish, realism, continuity, brand tone, or storytelling nuance.

safety_rewrite_mode.title: Safety Rewrite Mode
safety_rewrite_mode.description: How aggressively the skill should rewrite risky references into safe, original, media-model-friendly language.

youth_depiction_policy.title: Youth / Child Subject Policy
youth_depiction_policy.description: Choose whether babies, children, and teenagers may appear in safe age-appropriate contexts. This never permits sexualized or suggestive youth content.

oneOf.title: Allow Safe Youth Contexts
oneOf.description: Allow babies, children, and teenagers only in non-sexual, age-appropriate, educational, family, parenting, documentary, health, or everyday-life contexts.

oneOf.title: Block Youth Subjects
oneOf.description: Do not generate prompts centered on babies, children, or teenagers. Rewrite toward adult or neutral alternatives when needed.

adult_sensuality_policy.title: Adult Sensuality Policy
adult_sensuality_policy.description: Choose whether the skill may keep tasteful adult sensual or glamour cues in a media-safe, non-explicit way.

oneOf.title: Block Adult Sensuality
oneOf.description: Rewrite sexy or sensual requests toward fashion, confidence, romance, or editorial polish without sensual emphasis.

oneOf.title: Allow Tasteful Adult Sensuality
oneOf.description: Allow clearly adult, non-explicit sensual, glamorous, romantic, or fashion-editorial framing when it remains media-safe and age-unambiguous.

segment_title.title: Segment Title
segment_title.description: Optional short label such as Setup, Escalation, Reveal, or Ending.

duration_seconds.title: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: Length of this separate video clip. For the Veo 3.1 (Kie.ai) profile, treat each clip as 8 seconds.

segment_focus.title: Segment Focus
segment_focus.description: Optional note describing what story beat or cinematic focus this specific clip should carry.

oneOf.title: Character Reference
oneOf.description: Use this image for facial identity, hairstyle, wardrobe silhouette, and character continuity. Multiple images may share this role.

oneOf.title: Style Reference
oneOf.description: Use this image for lighting, color palette, texture, and overall visual treatment.

oneOf.title: Scene Composition Reference
oneOf.description: Use this image for framing, environment layout, camera distance, and subject placement.

oneOf.title: Product / Prop Reference
oneOf.description: Use this image for product shape, materials, hero details, or a key prop.

oneOf.title: Supporting Reference
oneOf.description: Use this image for secondary art direction, mood support, or supporting details.

oneOf.title: Unused
oneOf.description: Ignore this image in the final prompt.

guidance_focus.title: Guidance Focus

examples.topic: A lone night courier carrying a glowing data capsule through rain-soaked futuristic Bangkok
examples.prompt_goal: Create three different cinematic versions of the same courier concept. All spoken dialogue should be in Thai if dialogue is used, but each version should present a different mood and cinematic angle while keeping the same courier identity and futuristic Bangkok world.

video_segments.segment_focus: A restrained noir version focused on mood, tension, and stillness.
A more dynamic version with readable movement and pursuit energy.
A more poetic version with quiet atmosphere and a reflective final pose.

examples.main_subject: A Thai male night courier in his late 20s with sharp features, black technical coat with subtle neon trim, calm but alert expression.
examples.setting: Rain-soaked neon alley in futuristic Bangkok at night, wet pavement, drifting steam, glowing Thai signs.
examples.action: Create three separate cinematic versions from the same courier topic: one restrained and tense, one dynamic and urgent, and one quiet and reflective.
examples.blocking_and_staging: Keep the courier's body language controlled, alert, and readable in every version, while allowing each prompt to present a different cinematic angle.
examples.foreground_midground_background: Foreground steam and rain droplets, courier in the midground, layered neon signs and wet alley depth in the background.
examples.dialogue_or_text: A short Thai line may appear only if it strengthens the scene, otherwise let the visuals carry the emotion.
examples.reference_image_notes: @Image1 is the primary face and identity reference. @Image2 is a second character reference for coat silhouette and distinctive wardrobe details. @Image3 should guide alley composition, wet reflections, and neon atmosphere.
examples.must_include: stable face identity, readable hand interaction with the data capsule, cinematic rain atmosphere, and clearly different creative treatments across the three videos
examples.avoid: flicker, extra limbs, deformed hands, chaotic background warping, messy object motion
examples.additional_notes: Keep the result premium and believable, like alternate teaser concepts from the same streaming-series world. Each prompt should stand alone as an option the user can choose later.
